title: "No reason why everyone should have an identical Claude experience": Anthropic's mods let you change Claude Code's look and behavior
author: Paul Sawers
zh_title: 每个人都不必千篇一律：Anthropic的模组功能让你自定义Claude Code的外观与行为
zh_summary: Anthropic推出了Claude Code模组（Mods）功能，允许开发者通过JavaScript或TypeScript编写小型函数，自定义Claude Code的外观、行为、界面及工具调用，从而实现更个性化的开发体验。
